hero.body: TODO ig: Summoned into the realm of Ogbun'abali, the Igbo deity of punishment and games, champions from the living world are forced to compete in a divine spectacle where survival is entertainment and power is earned through trial.

story.title: TODO ig: SOMA WAS NEVER MEANT TO BECOME A HERO

story.body2: TODO ig: Caught between life and death, he was offered a second chance by Ogbun'abali, the god of punishment and games. Resurrected with awakened chi abilities, Soma is thrust into a world where gods, spirits, and hidden forces shape the fate of nations.

hero.title: TODO ig: THE SOULS THAT SHAPE THE REALM
hero.body: TODO ig: The world of Beyond Service is shaped by powerful individuals whose choices ripple across both the mortal and divine realms. Some fight for survival. Some seek power. Others exist to test those bold enough to enter the Trial.
hero.aside: TODO ig: Meet the champions, gods, and legendary figures whose stories define the Beyond Service universe.

soma.name: TODO ig: SOMA
soma.alt: TODO ig: Soma, seen from behind, the sun tattoo across his shoulder
bio: TODO ig: Once an ordinary youth corps member, Soma’s life changed forever when he accepted a pact with Ogbun’abali after death. Resurrected with extraordinary chi abilities, he became one of the first ascendants to challenge the boundary between the mortal and divine worlds.
TODO ig: Versatile and adaptable, Soma excels at balancing offense, mobility, and crowd control, making him a reliable choice for both new and experienced players.

intro: TODO ig: Soma is the all-rounder. He combines mobility, offense, crowd control, and adaptability, making him effective in almost any situation.
TODO ig: He's designed for players who want flexibility and the ability to respond to different combat scenarios without being locked into a single playstyle.
lore: TODO ig: Soma never imagined that death would become the beginning of his story.

TODO ig: A recent university graduate serving his country through the National Youth Service Corps, Soma's life was cut short during a violent ambush while traveling home with his closest friends. In the moments between life and death, he encountered Ogbun'abali, the god of punishment and games, who offered him an impossible choice: remain among the dead or return to the world of the living and participate in a series of divine trials.
TODO ig: Soma chose to live.

TODO ig: Resurrected with extraordinary chi abilities and supernatural combat instincts, he set out to rescue his captured friends. What began as a personal mission quickly evolved into something much larger as he uncovered a hidden network of ritualists manipulating events from the shadows.

TODO ig: Despite the power he now possesses, Soma remains driven by loyalty, responsibility, and a deep desire to protect others. He carries the burden of both worlds on his shoulders, balancing his humanity against the growing influence of divine power.

abilities.name: TODO ig: FAST PUNCH
abilities.text: TODO ig: A rapid series of electrified strikes that builds combo momentum and charges Soma's chi.

abilities.name: TODO ig: GROUND SLAM
abilities.text: TODO ig: Channels chi through his gauntlet to create a localized shockwave that damages nearby enemies.

abilities.name: TODO ig: SPIRIT LOCK
abilities.text: TODO ig: A grappling ability that launches opponents and creates openings for follow-up attacks.

abilities.name: TODO ig: IJE MMUO (SPIRIT PATH)
abilities.text: TODO ig: Soma's ultimate ability. He summons ancestral spiritual energy in a devastating burst that overwhelms enemies in front of him.

variants.name: TODO ig: GAUNTLET VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Soma's default fighting style combines close-range combat with powerful electrical chi abilities. Fast, versatile, and adaptable, it rewards players who enjoy balanced gameplay and fluid combos.

variants.name: TODO ig: HATCHET VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: A more tactical combat style focused on precision, range, and battlefield control. By channeling ancestral energy through enchanted hatchets, Soma gains access to devastating mid-range attacks and powerful area denial abilities.

kaira.name: TODO ig: KAIRA
kaira.alt: TODO ig: Kaira in a corps jacket, arms spread

intro: TODO ig: Kaira fights on her own terms. She controls space, punishes impatience, and turns a crowded arena into a corridor of her choosing.
TODO ig: She is built for players who would rather set a trap than win a trade, and who enjoy reading an opponent before touching them.
lore: TODO ig: The corridors remember her before anyone else does.

TODO ig: Kaira was a boarding-school prefect with a reputation for knowing things she should not have known. When the trials took her, they took her at midnight, in a hallway that has not been used since.
TODO ig: She did not ask to come back. She asked to be believed.
TODO ig: What returned wears her uniform and her name, and it moves through the arena the way a rumour moves through a dormitory — never quite where you looked, always already ahead of you.
TODO ig: Kaira fights to be remembered correctly. Every opponent she leaves standing is one more mouth to carry the story she was denied.

abilities.name: TODO ig: KOI KOI
abilities.text: TODO ig: A step that leaves an afterimage. Opponents who strike it are slowed and marked for her next attack.

abilities.name: TODO ig: HALL PASS
abilities.text: TODO ig: Kaira opens a short corridor of space, pulling herself through it and anyone careless enough to be standing in the way.

abilities.name: TODO ig: LIGHTS OUT
abilities.text: TODO ig: Dims the arena in a radius around her, cutting enemy vision while leaving her own untouched.

abilities.name: TODO ig: ROLL CALL
abilities.text: TODO ig: Her ultimate. Kaira names every opponent she has marked, striking each of them at once wherever they stand.

variants.name: TODO ig: PREFECT VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Her default style. Measured, punishing, and built around control — it rewards players who set the terms of an engagement before it begins.

variants.name: TODO ig: MIDNIGHT VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: A faster, riskier style that trades her zoning tools for pursuit. Kaira gives up the corridor and hunts in the open instead.

ogbunabali.name: TODO ig: OGBUN'ABALI
ogbunabali.role: TODO ig: The God of Punishment and Games
ogbunabali.alt: TODO ig: Ogbun'abali enthroned in gold

intro: TODO ig: Ogbun'abali does not fight so much as rule. He sets conditions, and the arena enforces them.
TODO ig: He is the heaviest character in the roster and the least forgiving to play, built for people who want to win by making the rules rather than by moving faster.
lore: TODO ig: He is the reason there is a game at all.

TODO ig: The god of punishment and games keeps no temple and takes no worship. He keeps a ledger. Every debt that goes unpaid in the living world is written into it, and every name in it is eventually called.
TODO ig: The trials are not a test. They are a collection.

TODO ig: Those who reach him find neither cruelty nor mercy, only arithmetic — a precise accounting of what was owed and what has been paid. He has never been known to make an error, and he has never been known to forgive one.
TODO ig: That he fights at all is a courtesy. He is settling an account either way.

abilities.name: TODO ig: THE LEDGER
abilities.text: TODO ig: Marks an opponent with a debt. Damage they deal is recorded and returned to them when the mark expires.

abilities.name: TODO ig: SENTENCE
abilities.text: TODO ig: A downward strike that pins an enemy in place for the duration of a count only he can hear.

abilities.name: TODO ig: COLLECTION
abilities.text: TODO ig: Drags every marked opponent toward him, closing the distance he refuses to travel himself.

abilities.name: TODO ig: NIGHT COURT
abilities.text: TODO ig: His ultimate. The arena darkens and every debt on the field is called in at once.

variants.name: TODO ig: THRONE VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: His default. Slow, immovable, and overwhelming at close range — it rewards players willing to hold ground and let opponents come to them.

variants.name: TODO ig: ARBITER VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Trades raw power for reach and marking speed, turning him from a wall into a presence that reaches across the whole arena.

nzeUgwuoke.name: TODO ig: NZE UGWUOKE
nzeUgwuoke.role: TODO ig: The Fallen Chief Priest
nzeUgwuoke.alt: TODO ig: Nze Ugwuoke in a red cap and ivory beads

intro: TODO ig: Nze Ugwuoke hits harder than anyone else on the roster and asks very little of the player in return.
TODO ig: He is the entry point to the game — direct, durable, and honest about what he intends to do next.
lore: TODO ig: He was the last chief priest of a shrine that no longer has a village.

TODO ig: For forty years Nze Ugwuoke kept the rites, settled disputes, and buried the dead of a community that slowly stopped coming. When the road came through and the last family left, he stayed, because leaving would have meant admitting it was over.
TODO ig: The trials found him alone, still keeping a calendar nobody read.
TODO ig: He fights now with the same stubbornness that kept him at an empty shrine — not for glory, and not for return, but because putting something down is harder for him than carrying it.

abilities.name: TODO ig: OPENING RITE
abilities.text: TODO ig: A heavy overhand strike that staggers an opponent and opens them to a follow-up.

abilities.name: TODO ig: STANDING GROUND
abilities.text: TODO ig: Nze plants himself. Incoming damage is reduced sharply while he does not move.

abilities.name: TODO ig: OATH BREAKER
abilities.text: TODO ig: A shoulder charge that carries an opponent across the arena and into whatever is behind them.

abilities.name: TODO ig: LAST RITES
abilities.text: TODO ig: His ultimate. A sustained series of blows that cannot be interrupted once it begins.

variants.name: TODO ig: SHRINE VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: His default. Slow, heavy, and forgiving, with generous timing windows — the most straightforward style in the game.

variants.name: TODO ig: ELDER VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Sacrifices some of his durability for reach and speed, giving him answers to opponents who refuse to stand and trade.

lieutenant.name: TODO ig: LIEUTENANT
lieutenant.alt: TODO ig: The Lieutenant in a feathered war helm

intro: TODO ig: The Lieutenant fights by formation. His strength is in position, timing, and denying an opponent the ground they need.
TODO ig: He suits players who think a move or two ahead and would rather shape a fight than react to one.
lore: TODO ig: He gave an order he could not take back.

TODO ig: The Lieutenant commanded men who trusted him completely, right up to the moment that trust cost them everything. He does not dispute the account. He disputes only that it should have been him who survived it.
TODO ig: The trials offered him a command again. He accepted before hearing the terms.
TODO ig: He fights precisely, economically, and without any apparent interest in winning — as though the arena were a drill he intends to run correctly this time, whatever the result.

abilities.name: TODO ig: HOLD THE LINE
abilities.text: TODO ig: Plants a marker. Allies and summons near it take reduced damage; enemies crossing it are slowed.

abilities.name: TODO ig: SUPPRESSING FIRE
abilities.text: TODO ig: A ranged volley that denies an area rather than dealing heavy damage.

abilities.name: TODO ig: FLANK
abilities.text: TODO ig: A short dash that repositions him behind an opponent and briefly turns them away from him.

abilities.name: TODO ig: FINAL ORDER
abilities.text: TODO ig: His ultimate. Calls in the formation he lost, striking every enemy caught inside his markers.

variants.name: TODO ig: FIELD VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: His default. Balanced between ranged control and close defence, rewarding players who manage space deliberately.

variants.name: TODO ig: BROKEN VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Abandons his markers entirely for raw aggression — faster, far more fragile, and built for players who want the fight over quickly.

theBeast.name: TODO ig: THE BEAST
theBeast.alt: TODO ig: The Beast in a horned mask and raffia collar

intro: TODO ig: The Beast is built around pursuit. Once it has a target, everything it does is in service of closing the distance.
TODO ig: It rewards players who commit, and punishes those who open a chase they cannot finish.
lore: TODO ig: It was not summoned. It was released.
TODO ig: The mask predates the trials by a long way, and whatever wore it first is no longer distinguishable from what wears it now. The horns are not decoration. They are a count.
TODO ig: It does not speak, negotiate, or retreat.
TODO ig: What is known is behavioural: it selects one opponent at the start of every trial and does not deviate from that choice for any reason, including its own survival.

abilities.name: TODO ig: SCENT
abilities.text: TODO ig: Marks a single opponent for the whole trial. The Beast gains speed while moving toward them.

abilities.name: TODO ig: GORE
abilities.text: TODO ig: A charging horn strike that carries its target and pins them against terrain.

abilities.name: TODO ig: RUN THEM DOWN
abilities.text: TODO ig: A sustained sprint that cannot be turned quickly but cannot easily be outpaced either.

abilities.name: TODO ig: THE COUNT
abilities.text: TODO ig: Its ultimate. Damage against its marked target is massively increased for a short window.

variants.name: TODO ig: HORNED VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Its default. Heavy, committed, and devastating in a straight line, with almost no ability to change direction mid-attack.

variants.name: TODO ig: STALKING VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Trades charge damage for patience — slower to commit, far harder to shake once it has.

ojiIsi.name: TODO ig: OJI ISI
ojiIsi.alt: TODO ig: Oji Isi, a hooded mass of hair on bound legs

intro: TODO ig: Oji Isi does not attack in any conventional sense. It arrives, and the arena changes around it.
TODO ig: The least explained character in the roster, and the one that asks players to unlearn the most.
lore: TODO ig: Nobody has recorded it moving.

TODO ig: Oji Isi appears in places it was not, and the interval is never observed. Fighters who have faced it describe the encounter differently every time they are asked, including fighters describing the same encounter.
TODO ig: It has no recorded role in the trials and no known reason to be in them.
TODO ig: The one consistent account is this: it is always already there when you turn around, and it has never once been the first to act.

abilities.name: TODO ig: ELSEWHERE
abilities.text: TODO ig: Oji Isi is briefly not where it appears to be. Attacks aimed at it during this window pass through.

abilities.name: TODO ig: STILL
abilities.text: TODO ig: Halts an opponent mid-action. The effect ends the moment Oji Isi is looked at directly.

abilities.name: TODO ig: COLD FLOOR
abilities.text: TODO ig: The ground beneath an opponent stops returning momentum, cancelling dashes and charges.

abilities.name: TODO ig: TURN AROUND
abilities.text: TODO ig: Its ultimate. Oji Isi is behind every opponent on the field at once, for exactly as long as it takes them to react.

variants.name: TODO ig: OMEN VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Its default. Almost entirely defensive, built on denial and timing rather than damage.

variants.name: TODO ig: VIGIL VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: A slower, heavier style that trades its evasion for a persistent presence opponents must fight through.

ogbuagu.name: TODO ig: OGBUAGU
ogbuagu.alt: TODO ig: Ogbuagu, a pale spirit in a silver mask

intro: TODO ig: Ogbuagu trades its own condition for pressure. It is strongest when it should already have lost.
TODO ig: Built for players comfortable running low and confident they can finish before the arithmetic catches up.
lore: TODO ig: The mask is silver because the face beneath it was not left intact.
TODO ig: Ogbuagu and Mkpume came out of the same trial and the same failure, and the arena has never fully separated them since. They are counted as two. They have never behaved as two.
TODO ig: It fights in a way that suggests it does not expect to stop.
TODO ig: Damage registers. It simply does not appear to change anything about what happens next.

abilities.name: TODO ig: GRAVE DEBT
abilities.text: TODO ig: Ogbuagu spends its own health to increase its damage for a short window.

abilities.name: TODO ig: PALE REACH
abilities.text: TODO ig: An extended grab that pulls a distant opponent into close range.

abilities.name: TODO ig: SECOND BREATH
abilities.text: TODO ig: Converts recent damage taken into a burst of movement speed.

abilities.name: TODO ig: TWIN RITE
abilities.text: TODO ig: Its ultimate. Strikes the same point twice — once where the opponent is, and once where they are about to be.

variants.name: TODO ig: REVENANT VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Its default. Aggressive and self-damaging, rewarding players who can close a fight before the cost lands.

variants.name: TODO ig: MOURNING VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: A defensive style that banks damage taken rather than spending health, trading tempo for staying power.

mkpume.name: TODO ig: MKPUME
mkpume.alt: TODO ig: Mkpume, a pale spirit in a silver mask

intro: TODO ig: Mkpume is the patient half. Where Ogbuagu spends, Mkpume waits, and the arena rarely notices the difference until late.
TODO ig: It suits players who want the same pressure without the same risk, and who are willing to take longer to apply it.
lore: TODO ig: The second mask was made from the first, and the metal remembers it.

TODO ig: Mkpume came out of the trial that took Ogbuagu, wearing the same silver and answering to a different name. Which of them was there first is not settled, and neither of them has ever been asked.
TODO ig: It moves a fraction behind everything Ogbuagu does.
TODO ig: Fighters who have faced both report the same thing: you beat one of them, and the other was watching how.

abilities.name: TODO ig: STONE DEBT
abilities.text: TODO ig: Stores incoming damage instead of taking it, releasing it on Mkpume's next strike.

abilities.name: TODO ig: COLD REACH
abilities.text: TODO ig: A slower grab than Ogbuagu's with far greater range and no recovery window.

abilities.name: TODO ig: PATIENCE
abilities.text: TODO ig: Standing still increases Mkpume's damage. The bonus is lost the instant it is hit.

abilities.name: TODO ig: TWIN ANSWER
abilities.text: TODO ig: Its ultimate. Repeats the last ability used against it, at Mkpume's own strength.

variants.name: TODO ig: REVENANT VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Its default. Deliberate and punishing, built for players who would rather absorb a fight than start one.

variants.name: TODO ig: QUARRY VARIANT
variants.text: TODO ig: Gives up its stored damage for reach and mobility, turning it into a slower, heavier hunter.
